snippet.title: For Evelyn - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
For Evelyn is an intriguing tale of love, betrayal, and the ultimate sacrifice, combining point & click with classic adventure and RPG mechanics. Step into the world of Aura and unravel the truth about the past while completing quests, meeting new friends, and fighting to protect the ones you love! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292860/For_Evelyn/

Links: https://talehammer.carrd.co/ 
For Evelyn II: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248960/For_Evelyn_II__Shards_of_Creation/ 
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TaleHammer
